description:
SelectPdf Html To Pdf Converter for .NET - Community Edition is the free version of the powerful html to pdf converter available in SelectPdf Library for .NET.

The converter offers a lot of powerful options (convert any web page to pdf, convert any html string to pdf, html5/css3/javascript support, headers and footers support, etc) and the only limitation is that it can generate pdf documents up to 5 pages long.

This package contains the Chromium (CEF) rendering engine Windows binaries for SelectPdf Html To Pdf Converter for .NET Framework 2.0 and 4.0. Install alongside the Select.HtmlToPdf package to enable the Chromium (CEF) rendering engine for html to pdf conversions.
summary: Chromium (CEF) Windows binaries for SelectPdf Free Html To Pdf for .NET Framework 2.0 / 4.0 - Community Edition.
title: SelectPdf Html To Pdf Converter for .NET - Community Edition (FREE) - Chromium (CEF) Binaries (Windows)
